posts.title: Pinned: what TifoMaker is
posts.text:
تيفو ناديك، بملعبه الحقيقي، كرسي كرسي.
تختار النادي، ترسم، وتشوفه يرتفع بالمدرج بالـ3D قبل ما تطبع ولا كرت.
مجاني، ومن جوالك.
posts.gloss: Your club's tifo, in its real ground, seat by seat. Pick the club, draw, and watch it go up in the stand in 3D before you print a single card. Free, from your phone. (Reply: Try it, link.)

asset.file: marketing/video/x-promo/tifomaker-x-promo-1080p-clean.mp4

posts.why: The pinned post is what every new visitor reads first, so it says the one thing in plain Gulf Arabic. The link goes in the first reply because posts with links in the main text are reported to get less reach on X.
posts.measure: Profile visits and link clicks over the week. Pin it and leave it.

posts.title: English intro for Premier League and LaLiga fans
posts.text:
Your club's tifo, in its real ground, one seat at a time.

147 real stadiums. Anfield, the Bernabéu, Kingdom Arena. Draw it, then watch it go up on match night in 3D.

Free, in your browser.

asset.file: marketing/social/media-kit/img/liverpool.jpg, real-madrid.jpg, ittihad.jpg, hero.jpg

posts.why: About a third of visits are in English. Naming the grounds people know does the selling without adjectives.
posts.measure: Link clicks from the reply, bookmarks.

posts.format: Text post with one image of the Ettifaq ground
posts.title: Matchday 13: you write the Ettifaq tifo
posts.text:
السبت الاتفاق يستقبل الهلال.

لو جمهور الاتفاق بيرفع تيفو… وش تكتبون فيه؟

أحسن رد نرسمه على مدرج ملعب الاتفاق الحقيقي، وننزله الجمعة.
posts.gloss: Saturday Ettifaq host Al-Hilal. If the Ettifaq fans were raising a tifo, what would you write on it? We draw the best reply on the real Ettifaq stand and post it Friday.

asset.file: Screenshot of Ettifaq's ground in the Stadium view, empty stand

posts.why: Replies are the strongest signal on X. This gives fans a job they enjoy, and the winner has a reason to share Friday's post. Rotate which club gets it each round so the account stays every club's.
posts.measure: Number of replies, and how many are real ideas rather than one-word answers.
posts.depends: Ettifaq v Al-Hilal is listed for Sat 28 Nov in third-party fixture lists. Check the SPL site before posting.

posts.title: Payoff: the winning reply, drawn
posts.text:
فاز رد @[اسم الحساب] 👏
"[نص الرد]"

هذا هو على مدرج الاتفاق. [عدد] كرت، [عدد الألوان] ألوان.
posts.gloss: @[account]'s reply won. Here it is on the Ettifaq stand: [N] cards, [N] colours. (Reply: Want it in your club's ground? link)

asset.file: Render of the winning tifo in Match Day, plus the card count from the bill of materials

posts.why: Closing the loop is what makes people reply to the next one. The card count is something only we can say.
posts.measure: Reposts and quotes, and whether the winner shares it.
posts.depends: Fill in after x-03 gets replies.

posts.title: Every Roshn League ground in its real blocks
posts.text:
ملاعب دوري روشن صارت مرسومة ببلوكاتها الحقيقية.

الدرج بمكانه، الممرات، فتحات المداخل، وأسماء البلوكات نفس اللي على تذكرتك.

يعني إذا قلت للقروب "التيفو من C3 إلى C7"، تشوف بالضبط وين بيطلع.
posts.gloss: The Roshn League grounds are now drawn in their real blocks: the stairs where they are, the walkways, the tunnels, and block names as printed on your ticket. So if you tell the group 'the tifo runs from C3 to C7', you see exactly where it goes up.

asset.file: Screenshot of a ground from above with its block names (scripts/block-plan.mts draws this)

posts.why: An announcement written as what it lets a fan do, with a real block name, reads like a fan talking. 'We are proud to announce' would read like a company.
posts.measure: Bookmarks and replies asking for a ground that isn't there yet (that list is the build queue).

posts.title: Tifo of the Week (template)
posts.text:
تيفو الأسبوع 🏟️
@[المصمم] رسمه لـ[النادي] على [الملعب].
[جملة وحدة عن شيء محدد عجبنا فيه]
posts.gloss: Tifo of the week: @[designer] drew it for [club] at [ground]. [One line on something specific we liked.] (Reply: see it in 3D, design link.)

asset.file: You pick one community design each week; I write the line

posts.why: Fans share posts about themselves. It also shows new visitors what ordinary fans make, which converts better than our own renders.
posts.measure: Shares by the featured designer, new sign-ups that weekend.

posts.when: Within 3 hours of any real tifo reveal
posts.format: Quote post of the fan group's video, plus our render
posts.title: Match-night reveal (template)
posts.text:
تيفو [اسم الرابطة] الليلة 👏
الفكرة: [المعنى بسطر واحد]

رسمناه على نفس المدرج عشان نعرف كم تعبوا: تقريباً [عدد] كرت. الشغل الحقيقي لهم.
posts.gloss: [Group]'s tifo tonight. The idea: [meaning in one line]. We drew it on the same stand to see how much work it was: about [N] cards. The real work is theirs.

asset.file: Quick redraw in TifoMaker on the same ground, and the card count

posts.why: Saudi media already writes whole articles about tifos (Al-Hilal's 3PTS tifo reached Marca and The Athletic). The card count adds something nobody else has, and the credit keeps the ultras groups on side.
posts.measure: Impressions compared with our usual posts; whether the group reposts it.

posts.title: Asian Cup: one month to the opener
posts.text:
بعد شهر بالضبط، الأخضر يفتتح كأس آسيا بالرياض 🇸🇦

نبي نشوف تيفو الأخضر منكم.
صمّموه، وأحسن 3 تصاميم ننزلها هنا وبتيك توك يوم الافتتاح.
posts.reply:
صمّم على استاد الملك فهد 👇
tifomaker.org
posts.gloss: Exactly one month from now, Saudi Arabia open the Asian Cup in Riyadh. We want to see your Al-Akhdar tifo. Design it, and we post the best 3 here and on TikTok on opening day.

asset.file: King Fahd Sports City in the app (not built yet), and a 10s render

posts.why: The biggest football moment in the country this winter, at home. A fan contest keeps the account national rather than one club's.
posts.measure: Designs made on the King Fahd ground between 7 Dec and 7 Jan.
posts.depends: Needs decision D-08 (build King Fahd Sports City) and D-07 (prizes). Opener: 7 Jan 2027, King Fahd Sports City, per AFC schedule.

posts.title: Post the three ready hooks first
posts.text: صمّم تيفو ناديك بموقع مجاني 🔥 وش ناديك؟ 👇
posts.gloss: Design your club's tifo on a free site. What's your club?
script: Three cuts are already made in marketing/video: tiktok_v2_hookA, hookB, hookC. Same video, different first second.
If they haven't gone out, post one a day, starting with hook C (لو ناديك يطلع بتيفو كذا؟).
Mute the file's music in TikTok and add a trending sound in the app.

asset.file: marketing/video/tiktok_v2_hookC.mp4 (then A, then B)

posts.why: These were made to fix what went wrong with video 1 (English, slow hook, read like an ad). Testing them costs nothing and tells us which first second works for this audience.
posts.measure: Viewers still watching at 1s and 3s, for each hook. The winner becomes the template.

posts.title: "Comment your club" series, episode 1
posts.text: أول 3 أندية بالتعليقات أرسم لهم تيفو بملعبهم 👇
posts.gloss: The first 3 clubs in the comments, I draw their tifo in their ground.
script: 0.0–0.6s: open mid-flare on the AHLAWI stand, no intro.
0.6–6s: fast cuts, blue stand, gold stand, green stand (the three reels in marketing/assets).
6–9s: slow push across the full bowl.
Last frame matches the first so it loops.

asset.file: marketing/assets/reel_blue.mp4, reel_gold.mp4, reel_green.mp4, bowl-wide frame

posts.why: Asking for the club name is the cheapest comment there is, and club loyalty does the rest. Every comment becomes the next video, so the series feeds itself.
posts.measure: Comments per 1,000 views. Over 15 means the series is working.

posts.when: Thu 26 Nov · 21:30, then as comments come in
posts.title: Reply to a comment: build it on screen
posts.text: طلبتوا [النادي]… هذا هو بملعبه 🔥 مين بعده؟
posts.gloss: You asked for [club]... here it is in its ground. Who's next?
onscreen: Comment sticker from TikTok's reply feature
script: Use TikTok's 'Reply with video' on a real comment, so the comment shows on screen.
0–1s: the finished tifo first, at full size.
1–14s: screen recording of the build at 8x speed, seat colours filling in.
14–18s: Match Day camera rising over the stand.

asset.file: Screen recording of the build plus a Match Day capture (about 20 minutes per club)

posts.why: A reply video carries the fan's own comment, so it reads as a conversation, not an ad, and that fan shares it.
posts.measure: Shares, and whether the commenter reposts.

posts.title: Ettifaq or Hilal: one ground, two ends
posts.text: مدرج الاتفاق ولا مدرج الهلال؟ اكتب 1 أو 2 👇
posts.gloss: Ettifaq's end or Al-Hilal's end? Write 1 or 2.
script: Both tifos drawn on Ettifaq's ground, home end and away end.
0–4s: home end goes up.
4–8s: camera swings to the away end, it goes up.
8–12s: wide shot of both together.

asset.file: Two designs on Ettifaq's ground, one Match Day capture

posts.why: A 1-or-2 vote is the easiest comment to leave, and both sets of fans share it to win. Post it the night before the match.
posts.measure: Comment count, and the split between 1 and 2 (the next post can announce the result).

posts.title: How many cards does a full-stand tifo take?
posts.text: تيفو مدرج كامل يحتاج كم كرت؟ خمّن قبل نهاية الفيديو 👇
posts.gloss: How many cards does a full-stand tifo need? Guess before the end of the video.
script: 0–3s: the AHLAWI stand, still.
3–10s: slow zoom from the whole stand down to single seats.
11s: the total from the app's card count, large.
13s: the split by colour.

asset.file: The real card total for the AHLAWI design from the app's bill of materials

posts.why: A question with an answer at the end keeps people to the last second, and supporter groups save it because the number is useful to them.
posts.measure: Completion rate and saves.

posts.title: One person, every ground
posts.text: شخص واحد يرسم كل ملاعب الدوري… كرسي كرسي
posts.gloss: One person drawing every ground in the league, seat by seat.
onscreen: 0.0s  صورة الملعب الحقيقي ← النسخة اللي رسمتها
end   وش الملعب اللي تبيه بعده؟
script: 0–2s: split screen, real photo of Al-Awwal Park on the left, the app's model on the right (Claude outputs/al-awwal-before-after.png).
2–20s, your voice: how you measure a ground from photos, count the stairs, and name the blocks the way the tickets do.
20–30s: the finished ground with a tifo going up.
End on a question about which ground to build next.

asset.file: Your voice-over (about 25 seconds). Visuals already exist.

posts.why: A real person doing slow, careful work is the opposite of AI slop, and people root for a solo builder. It's also the post most likely to get you press.
posts.measure: Average watch time and follows from the video.
posts.depends: Needs decision D-02 (whether you appear, and how).

posts.title: Kingdom Arena, from empty to full tifo
posts.text: المملكة أرينا… من كراسي فاضية لتيفو كامل 💙
posts.gloss: Kingdom Arena, from empty seats to a full tifo.
script: 0–1s: the finished tifo flashes for half a second, then cut to the empty stand.
1–16s: build timelapse at 12x.
16–20s: Match Day camera; the last frame cuts back to the first.

asset.file: Screen recording of the build at Kingdom Arena

posts.why: Satisfying timelapses are watched twice, and a loop counts as a rewatch. Posting on match day catches people already searching for the club.
posts.measure: Rewatches (average watch time over 100%) and shares.
posts.depends: Al-Hilal v Al-Diriyah is listed for 3 Dec; check before posting.

posts.title: How to design a full-stand tifo, step by step
posts.text:
Title: طريقة تصميم تيفو لمدرج كامل خطوة بخطوة (مجاناً)

Show the finished tifo in the first 30 seconds, then build it.
Thumbnail: the stand mid-reveal, 3 words max: تيفو بدقايق.

asset.file: Screen recording plus voice-over

posts.title: Every Roshn League ground, inside, in 3D
posts.text:
Title: ملاعب دوري روشن من الداخل بالـ3D | كل البلوكات

Chapters: one per ground, with its name, so each one shows up in search.
posts.gloss: Title: The Roshn League grounds from the inside in 3D, every block.
script: Flyover of each ground for 30–40 seconds, with block names on screen.
Calm music, no voice needed.
End card: design your tifo in any of them.

asset.file: Flyover captures of the 18 grounds (the app has a flyover camera)

posts.why: Every chapter is a search result ('ملعب الإنماء من الداخل'). It's useful to fans planning which seats to buy, not only to tifo makers.

decisions.q: Which language leads on each platform?
decisions.rec: TikTok and YouTube: Arabic first, always. X: Arabic for everything Saudi, separate English posts for Premier League, LaLiga and big announcements.
decisions.why: 70% of the TikTok audience is Saudi, and up to 63% of site visits are in Arabic. Video 1 was in English and lost most viewers in the first second.

decisions.q: Who is the face and voice of the account?
decisions.rec: Start with your voice over screen recordings, no face. Do one founder video (tt-06) and see how it lands.
decisions.why: A real person's voice is the clearest sign this isn't AI content, and a voice is easier to keep up every week than filming yourself.

decisions.q: Can we use club crests and fan groups' photos?
decisions.rec: No official crests in our own posts: club colours and words only. Fan designs made in the app are fine. Always credit fan groups by handle, and ask before reusing their photos or videos.
decisions.why: Crests are trademarks. The groups are the people we most want on our side.

decisions.rec: Yes, the basic tier, for one quarter, then judge it on reach.
decisions.why: Several 2026 analyses say paid accounts get noticeably more reach, though nobody has measured it independently. It also adds the badge, edits and longer videos.

decisions.rec: X: 1–2 posts a day plus 15 minutes of replies. TikTok: 4 a week. YouTube: 3 Shorts a week and 1 long video every 2 weeks.
decisions.why: That's what one person can keep up without the quality dropping. Consistency matters more than volume.

decisions.q: How often do we mention Pro?
decisions.rec: At most 1 post in 8, and none on TikTok in the first month.
decisions.why: People follow for tifos. With 1 sale from 496 accounts, more sign-ups will help more than more sales pitches right now.

decisions.q: Prizes for the Asian Cup tifo contest?
decisions.rec: A year of Pro for each of the top 3, plus being shown on all three accounts on opening day.
decisions.why: It costs nothing to give and fans want it. Free entry, no purchase needed. Check whether a Saudi commerce licence is needed for a prize contest before announcing.

decisions.q: Build King Fahd Sports City before 7 January?
decisions.why: It hosts the Asian Cup opener and final. Without it, the biggest moment of the winter has no ground to design in.

decisions.rec: Nothing until a post beats our own average without help. Then SAR 50–100 of TikTok Promote behind that one post.
decisions.why: Paying to push a post that people don't watch only buys bad numbers.

decisions.rec: You post them yourself, in each app, after approving them here. TikTok sounds must be added in the app. X posts can be scheduled in X's own scheduler.
decisions.why: I can't post to X, TikTok or YouTube from here, so nothing goes out without you. Approvals on this page are the go-ahead I read back.
